normalization.group: SU(2), defining representation; full continuous normalized Haar measure
normalization.action: S_W=beta sum_p(1-Re Tr U_p/2), beta=4/g0^2, isotropic a_s=a_t
normalization.standardForce: For staple S_e, Z_e=-Im_quaternion(U_e S_e); Vdot_e=Z_e V_e
normalization.existingY6Conversion: t_standard=2*t_existing_Y6 for identical initial links; Y6 keeps its explicitly declared dV/dtau=-g0^2 grad_B S_W convention.
normalization.energy: E_clover=sum_mu<nu -Tr(F_mu_nu^2), F=(Q-Qdagger)/8 in lattice units; no beta or g0 factor
normalization.alternateEnergy: E_plaquette=4 sum_mu<nu(1-Re Tr U_mu_nu/2) per site
normalization.integrator: Third-order group Runge-Kutta, Luscher 1006.4518 Appendix C; full simultaneous link force
